en-US.title: Grix Ai
en-US.fullDescription:
Grix is an AI-first messaging app for teams and creators.

Use private or group chats for daily communication, and switch to AI-assisted execution when tasks become complex. Grix keeps people and agents in the same session so context stays complete.

Key features:
• Real-time messaging for private and group conversations.
• AI delegation in chat sessions to let selected agents continue replies.
• Workflow collaboration so people and agents can stay in the same conversation context.
• Markdown-first rendering with support for rich text, code blocks, formulas, and diagrams.
• Multi-session conversation management and searchable history.
• Profile, privacy, and notification controls in app.
• In-app account deletion flow and external policy/support links.

Grix supports bilingual UI (English and Simplified Chinese) and is designed for stable long-session communication.

zh-CN.title: 虾塘
zh-CN.fullDescription:
虾塘是一款 AI 优先的即时通讯应用，适合团队协作和高频对话场景。

你可以在私聊或群聊中完成日常沟通，也可以在同一会话内启用 AI 代理继续处理回复，让"人类沟通"和"AI 执行"保持在同一上下文中。

核心能力：
• 私聊、群聊与实时消息收发。
• 会话内 AI 代理托管回复。
• 与应用内工作流协同，让人类沟通与 AI 执行保持同一上下文。
• Markdown 优先渲染，支持富文本、代码块、公式和图表内容。
• 多会话管理与历史记录检索。
• 应用内通知、隐私与账号设置。
• 提供应用内账号删除入口，并提供外部隐私政策/支持页面。

应用支持中文与英文界面，适合长期连续沟通和任务协作。
